name: Haran
bio: Haran is the son of Terah, brother of Abram and Nahor, and father of Lot, Milcah, and Iscah. He died in Ur, his native land, while his father Terah was still living — a detail Scripture specifically notes (Genesis 11:27-29). Though he died young and never journeyed to Canaan with the rest of the family, his line continued through his son Lot and daughter Milcah in the ongoing story of Abraham's family.
